_comment: Display-only aliases for opaque MaxMind ASN owner strings.
Purely cosmetic: '31173 Services AB' means nothing to a human, 'Mullvad VPN'
means everything. Applied ONLY where an org is rendered. It is deliberately
NOT applied to the value used for org-FP matching, is_hyperscaler(), the
safe-org set, or the '*<first word>*' FP-pattern prefill — those all key on
the raw MaxMind string, and rewriting it would retroactively reinterpret
every org FP already written against it.
Keys must match the MaxMind org string exactly. Check one with:
Edited in place; reloaded on mtime change, no restart needed.
Site-local edits live in /var/lib/beaconbutty/org-aliases.json — this repo
copy is only the shipped default and is not overwritten on reinstall.
